_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "tone" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "name" TEXT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "manual_cost" INTEGER NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "option_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_select" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "max_select" INTEGER NULL, "allow_repeat" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_repeat" IN (0, 1)), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "option_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES option_groups (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_option_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES option_groups (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "cost_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reorder_point" INTEGER NULL, "reorder_qty" INTEGER NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "option_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES option_items (id), "stock_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_items (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tax_rates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "compound" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("compound" IN (0, 1)), "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_taxes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "tax_rate_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tax_rates (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "barcodes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_photos" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "image" BLOB NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_changes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "new_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "payment_terms_days" INTEGER NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "invoice_ref" TEXT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_now" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NULL, "received_by_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_receipt_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_receipts (id), "stock_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_items (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_counts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "blind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("blind" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "started_by_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "posted_at" INTEGER NULL, "posted_by_id" TEXT NULL, "posted_by_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_count_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_counts (id), "stock_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_items (id), "expected" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cashier_id" TEXT NULL, "cashier_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "voided_at" INTEGER NULL, "voided_by_id" TEXT NULL, "voided_by" TEXT NULL, "tax_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("device_id", "number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_name" TEXT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "addons" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "cost_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_taxes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "tax_rate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tendered" INTEGER NULL, "change_given" INTEGER NULL, "momo_reference" TEXT NULL, "customer" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES product_variants (id), "stock_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES stock_items (id), "quantity_change" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "sub_reason" TEXT NULL, "unit_cost_milli" INTEGER NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "ref_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "by_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "built_in" TEXT NULL, "permissions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "max_discount_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "staff" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roles (id), "pin_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "emergency_name" TEXT NULL, "emergency_phone" TEXT NULL, "id_number" TEXT NULL, "date_of_birth" INTEGER NULL, "started_on" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "staff_photos" ("staff_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES staff (id), "image" BLOB NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("staff_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_closes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start" INTEGER NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_sale_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_by_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_by_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sales_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "voided_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sales_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cash_takings" INTEGER NOT NULL, "momo_takings" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credit_takings" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_float" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NULL, "actor_name" TEXT NULL, "approver_id" TEXT NULL, "approver_name" TEXT NULL, "entity" TEXT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "details" TEXT NULL, "prev_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "hash" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("device_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
